card.title: Happy Monday — weekly billing forecast
card.financialSource: Trailing eight-week average of actual Happy Monday order weeks (2026-06-14 through 2026-08-08) from happymonday_orders; Square invoices to hello@happymonday.company confirm the same weekly totals, batched every one to three weeks
card.notes: Happy Monday orders two or three deliveries a week and settles them in batched invoices every one to three weeks, so cash is forecast a week at a time. $382.82 is the trailing eight-week average of actual order weeks (June 14 – August 8), counting quiet weeks as zero. Sensitivity: $352.76 over four weeks, $457.67 over thirteen, $529.05 over twenty-six — the trend is down, so the eight-week figure is the conservative live read. Each week's amount is booked in its own week; actual payment lands roughly one to two weeks later, so month boundaries are approximate. Disable this card for any week Happy Monday is closed; the forecast counts the larger of this average or the orders Happy Monday has actually placed for that week, so committed orders are never double counted.
